items.why: Shares rallied on continued optimism around the Meta Connect event and early traction for the Muse AI assistant, with strong app retention data and AI glasses announcements drawing investor attention.
Semiconductor stocks slid after the SOXX posted its worst week in a month. China's CXMT reported DRAM progress, raising competition fears across memory and chip names.
Crude jumped above $105 after Houthi strikes on Riyadh's airport and Russian attacks on Ukrainian energy facilities, despite the weekend talk of an energy ceasefire.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape. Tech lagged as chip weakness and profit-taking weighed on AI names, with Micron leading the sector lower.

market_note: Earnings season kicks off Tuesday with the big banks reporting, plus CPI on Wednesday.
summary: Stocks are mixed to start the week, with the Dow higher and the Nasdaq slipping. Chip stocks are dragging while Meta jumps on AI news and oil rallies on Middle East and Ukraine strikes.
